I told Hollis in the #central-team thread that the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at **Gate 47**.

- **Where that came from:** Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I answered from that channel. Pree posted Dock 23 there on Oct 14 and corrected it to Gate 47 that same morning, saying the wrong line had been read. No later messages in the channel change it. The active GBrain fact also says Gate 47, and the Dock 23 one is withdrawn.
- **A wording slip in my reply:** I wrote "she'd read the wrong line" about Pree. Neither Pree nor anyone in this conversation stated Pree's pronouns, so I should have said "Pree had read the wrong line." The facts in the reply are right; the wording is a small fix if you'd like me to post a corrected version.
